name: basketball-pov
description: 2K-style and phone-style basketball clips (three.js, rendered headless to MP4) driven by real motion capture: v4 is anatomical skeletons in a practice gym, v3 a tweener-cross-cross step-back three from the side, v2 a behind-the-player 1v1 breakdown.

scripts.render:v4: node tools/events2.mjs src/index4.html out/events4.json && python3 tools/audio_gym.py out/events4.json out/audio4.wav && node tools/render.mjs --page src/index4.html --viewport 1080x1920 --size 1080x1920 --out out/skeleton_gym_silent.mp4 --workers 3 && bash tools/mux.sh out/skeleton_gym_silent.mp4 out/audio4.wav out/skeleton_gym.mp4
scripts.render:v3: node tools/events2.mjs src/index3.html out/events3.json && python3 tools/audio.py out/events3.json out/audio3.wav && node tools/render.mjs --page src/index3.html --out out/tweener_silent.mp4 --workers 3 && bash tools/mux.sh out/tweener_silent.mp4 out/audio3.wav out/tweener.mp4
scripts.render:v3:skel: node tools/events2.mjs src/index3.html out/events3.json && python3 tools/audio.py out/events3.json out/audio3.wav && node tools/render.mjs --page src/index3.html --q skel --out out/tweener_skeleton_silent.mp4 --workers 3 && bash tools/mux.sh out/tweener_skeleton_silent.mp4 out/audio3.wav out/tweener_skeleton.mp4
scripts.render: node tools/events2.mjs && python3 tools/audio.py out/events2.json out/audio2.wav && node tools/render.mjs --page src/index2.html --out out/1v1_pov_silent.mp4 --workers 3 && bash tools/mux.sh out/1v1_pov_silent.mp4 out/audio2.wav out/1v1_pov.mp4
scripts.render:v1: node tools/events.mjs && python3 tools/audio.py && node tools/render.mjs --out out/ball_screen_pov_silent.mp4 --workers 3 && bash tools/mux.sh
